blurb: Guests play golf on an alternative spike facility with a dress code requiring collared shirts for men and appropriate attire for women. The club offers regular, promotional, senior, junior, twilight, and 9-hole rates, as well as club rentals. Tournament and outing packages include greens fees, cart, range balls, food and beverage options, prizes, and event organization.
extraNote: 24-hour cancellation/modification notice required for standard reservations · Tournament reservations for 16+ players require signed contract and deposit · Rain checks prorated based on holes completed, issued for inclement weather only, expire after one year, no refunds or credits · No carry-on beverages allowed; only food and drinks purchased on-site may be consumed · Cart path only around tees and greens, par 3s; special daily cart restrictions apply · City Club Marietta clubhouse, 510 Powder Springs Street, Marietta, GA 30064
